summary: Backend testing for Casino Spotter API complete. All 15 pytest tests passed covering auth (signup/login/me with valid+invalid tokens), techniques list/detail/404, legitimacy research for reputable (Bet365) and blacklisted (Lucky31) casinos, legitimacy history, analysis image upload via Gemini 3 Flash, analysis history, and unauth rejection.

minor.issue: On 401 (unauthenticated upload) returns 403 via HTTPBearer (auto_error=True). Acceptable but consider explicit 401 with WWW-Authenticate.
Internal DB-hint scam matching uses substring both ways (s in name_lower OR name_lower in s) — short user inputs like 'lucky' could false-match 'lucky31'. Consider exact or token-boundary matching.
File saved to local disk under /app/backend/uploads — not persistent across container redeploys; no size limit enforced.

action_items: Optional: tighten KNOWN_CASINOS substring matching to avoid accidental matches
Optional: return 401 (not 403) for missing bearer token on analysis upload
Optional: enforce max upload size and consider GridFS / object storage instead of local disk
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 525 lines — within limits, but consider splitting into routers (auth, techniques, legitimacy, analysis) if it grows
EmailStr from pydantic used correctly; bcrypt + JWT auth implemented properly with timezone-aware datetimes
MongoDB _id correctly excluded via projection in find/find_one queries — good
All env vars (MONGO_URL, DB_NAME, EMERGENT_LLM_KEY, JWT_SECRET) read via os.environ[] which fails fast if missing — good
LLM responses parsed via simple line-prefix matching — fragile if the model deviates from the exact format. Consider tolerant regex / fallback defaults (already partly there)
Uploaded files never cleaned up — long-term disk growth risk
test_credentials: Fresh users created per session via /api/auth/signup with test_<uuid>@cs.io / pass123!
seed_data_creation: Created multiple TEST_ users, 2 legitimacy reports (Bet365, Lucky31) and 1 analysis record under fresh test users. Not cleaned up — DB has small accumulation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_casino_spotter.py covers all 15 specified backend cases and passes in ~40s including Gemini and Claude LLM calls. Reuse it for regression. PNG-bytes generator embedded for tiny image uploads.
rca of the issue: No bugs; all assertions met. Legitimacy endpoint produced trust_score 28 for Lucky31 (low, as expected) and ~85+ for Bet365 with green flags. Gemini multimodal returned analysis text and techniques list on a 1x1 PNG without error.
